annual_restoration_rate.formula: 1.5 million ha / 6 years / 100000 ha per 1000 km2

central_built_up_path.population_series_model_proxy: PHL_PUB_WAT AAD ratio; this demand is exactly proportional to the inherited PSA Scenario 2 annual population series

idle_fallow_ceiling.model_use: All-year TAMUL on LNDOTHTOT mode 2; productive crop technologies remain free to expand.

model_rules.forest_floor: Forest activity is at least its 2020 stock in every year.
model_rules.brush_conversion_scope: The 80 percent ceiling applies only to net forest expansion above 2020. Brush remains available to cropland and built-up land through the national balance.
model_rules.built_up_path: built_up[y] is fixed annually to the central population-times-urban-share trajectory.
model_rules.preserved_fixed_class_rule: Each listed class remains equal to its reconciled 2020 stock in every year because no sourced transition trajectory is available.
model_rules.cropland_rule: Total cropland remains at least its reconciled 2020 stock; productive crop activity remains endogenous and demand-driven, while existing LNDOTHTOT mode 2 carries the nonnegative idle/fallow balance.
model_rules.idle_fallow_rule: Idle/fallow mode 2 is capped at its 2020 balancing stock of 5.2877 thousand km2 so it cannot absorb brush as an unsourced residual; productive cropland has no added upper bound.
model_rules.unallocated_rule: Unallocated modeled land uses TAMLL=0 and TAMUL=0.000001 thousand km2. The positive sentinel is required because MUIOGO omits numeric-zero activity bounds from the solver data; it represents at most 0.001 km2 (0.1 ha).

interpretation_limits: The 2.5 thousand km2/year value is a policy planning-rate proxy, not measured annual net forest-cover change.
The national aggregate bounds do not identify parcel-level legal status, tenure, slope, soil, biodiversity value, restoration survival, or cluster location.
The formulation limits net annual forest expansion relative to a cumulative envelope; it does not model a gross hectare-by-hectare transition flow.
The 80 percent forest-suitability factor is an old national planning screen, not a current parcel overlay; it is applied to the 2020 brush stock only.
The forest bound constrains net forest stock above 2020, not gross parcel-level brush-to-forest flows.
The built-up path assumes constant built-up area per urban resident; it does not spatially allocate development or model density policy.
A numeric-zero TAMUL is sparse/default in MUIOGO and does not create a solver constraint; the 0.000001-thousand-km2 sentinel is a software representation requirement, not physical unallocated land.
